 Iowa Comes to Lincoln to Take on #1 Nebraska Volleyball
 It’s Senior Night
 by Brianna C Nov 13, 2026, 11:00 PM UTC Facebook 
 Link 
 Nebraska Athletics Nebraska volleyball is finishing off their regular season at home this weekend. Iowa is coming to take on the #1 Huskers and Saturday will be Senior Night.
 It’s unknown whether the Husker seniors will return for a fifth year, but they are going to be honored regardless.
 Iowa Hawkeyes (13-16) (Big Ten 2-13) 
 2025 Record: 15-17
 Conference Record: 6-14
 Last NCAA Tournament: Iowa’s last appearance in the NCAA tournament was in 1994. They lost in the first round to Pitt.
 Nebraska and Iowa Volleyball teams have met 41 times and the Huskers are undefeated against the Hawkeyes. Nebraska has dropped five total sets to Iowa all time, two of those being when Iowa took the Huskers to five sets in 2019.
 Iowa started the season 11-3 in the non conference slate and then have only won two conference games. Their two wins have been against Rutgers, an upset against UCLA in late October.
 Offensively Iowa is led by Senior middles Hannah Wittingstall and Liv Mogridge with 260 and 256 kills respectively. Both average about 2.4 kills per set. Sophomore outside hitter Ksenija Tomic has 201 kills on the year and averages 2.18 per set.
 Junior setter Jenna Meitzler has 1113 assists on the year and averages 10.31 assists per set. Meitzler also has 30 services aces on the year. Junior libero Jaimie Marquardt leads the Hawkeyes with 33 aces.
 Defensively the Hawkeyes are led by Freshman libero Henlee Moszkowicz with 327 digs. Wittingstall and Mogridge are also the lead blockers for Iowa with 100 and 95 blocks respectively.
